blind.description: A stylized fantasy wooden crate packed with straw and holding nine corked potion bottles arranged in a 3x3 grid. The crate is constructed from light brown wooden planks with corner posts and metal studs, features looped rope handles on opposing sides, and has an unattached wooden lid resting propped against one corner. The bottles have spherical bases and small necks plugged with corks, containing liquids in red, green, and golden-yellow. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a square wooden box with rope handles extending from two sides and a tilted lid resting at the lower-right corner; inside, nine round, colorful bottle tops (in red, green, and yellow) are neatly arranged in a 3x3 grid surrounded by straw packing.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 1.3 to 1.5 ft tall) and around 1.5 to 2 ft wide including the propped lid.
